verdict.rationale: Veo is offered as a video-generation API, so documented concurrency limits and queue behavior for batch rendering is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack has no documentation of concurrency limits, rate quotas, batch submission or queue semantics. The docs cover creative features, multi-turn editing and model migration, and the community items about cost do not address concurrency or queueing.

support.subject: As a developer, concurrency limits and queue behavior for batch rendering are documented, so I can plan a production pipeline
